anchors.invariant: Global in_progress tracking must not exhaust a campaign's worker allowance when no act lease is held.
Current living behavior conflates in_progress bead status with the node mutex and max_inflight accounting.
dispatch currently derives both free capacity and in-flight paths from nodes whose status is in_progress.
Lease files already record node, holder, paths, timestamp, and held/released status but no campaign identity.
run owns campaign scope and calls conductor ready, wave, and take; campaign identity must cross those command boundaries explicitly.

acceptance.if_true: The reviewed contract cleanly separates campaign focus, held act leases, and bead tracking; same-campaign held leases consume capacity; unrelated status does not; all held leases still protect overlapping paths globally; command boundaries and legacy lease behavior are explicit enough to implement and test.
acceptance.if_false: The contract still derives capacity or collision safety from global bead status, depends on a harness-local pin implicitly, allows cross-campaign overlapping writes, or leaves legacy/no-campaign behavior unsafe or ambiguous.
